label: Diagram 1.5
caption: Diagram 1.5 | Heights of switches, sockets etc.
description: This drawing is an elevation showing a section of wall with a door roughly in the centre, drawn as a tall rectangle containing an inner door leaf with a small handle symbol, standing on a horizontal floor line. Two horizontal dashed lines run across the wall to indicate mounting heights, dimensioned on the left by vertical dimension lines with diagonal tick marks: the lower line is marked "450mm" above the floor and the upper line "1200mm". Above the upper line, to the left of the door, is a vertical line of text reading "door bells, entry phones"; no symbol is drawn on the line at that point. To the right of the door on the upper line is a single small square symbol. On the lower line, to the right of the door, are three small square symbols arranged in a row, with a short curved dashed line trailing from the rightmost one. To the right of the door, above the upper line, are four lines of vertical text reading, left to right, "switches", "sockets", "TV sockets" and "telephone jack points", corresponding respectively to the square symbol on the 1200mm line and, from left to right, the three symbols on the 450mm line. The caption at the foot reads "Diagram 1.5 Heights of switches, sockets etc."
